steps.en: Install your framework adapter and the Vite plugin as dev dependencies
steps.zh: 把框架适配包和 Vite 插件装成开发依赖

steps.en: Mount it at the app root, passing each library's panel as a plugin
steps.zh: 在应用根部挂载它，把各库的面板作为插件传入

steps.en: Draws one trigger and a dockable panel; each plugin renders in its own tab
steps.zh: 画出一个触发按钮和可停靠面板，每个插件各占一个标签页

steps.en: Add the Vite plugin first in your Vite config
steps.zh: 在 Vite 配置里把它的插件放在第一位

steps.en: In dev: stamps JSX with source lines and pipes console; on build: strips devtools
steps.zh: 开发时给 JSX 标上源码行号、转发 console；构建时删掉它

value.en: One panel hosts every library's inspector plus click-to-source, and none of it reaches the production bundle
value.zh: 一个面板装下所有库的调试器，还能点元素跳源码，而且一行都不会进生产包

sources: docs/quick-start.md (npm install -D @tanstack/react-devtools @tanstack/devtools-vite; <TanStackDevtools plugins={[...]} />; devtools() first in Vite plugins)
docs/architecture.md (Solid.js core shell, adapters, inject-source, console piping, remove-devtools-on-build)
